verdict.rationale: LibreOffice states it is offered 'at no cost to you', so the whole product is effectively a permanent free tier. A developer can run real conversions with the documented headless --convert-to CLI, and a community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize formats. missing for 10: no hosted trial or sandbox environment documented, and no free-versus-paid usage limits described because no paid tier is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, a free tier, trial, or sandbox lets me test real conversions before paying

citations.quote: LibreOffice provides unfettered access to our office productivity tools, at no cost to you.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
